title: 第936章 不好他要突破了第935章 荒仙大劫
lines: “万古时空破杀！”
楚的身形化作一道金色闪电，速度快到极致，在五人之间穿梭游走。
每一次闪烁，必有一道凌厉的电光劈出，专攻敌人破绽，刁钻狠辣。
一时间，竟逼得永夜君王和轮回魔主两尊存在连连后退。
叶无缺也没有闲着。
他知道自己境界最低，便没有硬拼永恒超脱级别的攻击，而是凭借着对时空道则的感悟，游走在战场边缘，专门针对五人的招式破绽进行袭扰。
大战，就此陷入了僵持。
一时间，整片荒仙纪元的核心区域，道则崩碎，时空塌陷，无数星辰在余波之中化为飞灰。
这是足以覆灭一个纪元的恐怖大战！
然而，随着时间的推移，诸天一方的劣势渐渐显现了出来。
五尊永恒超脱巅峰联手，配合默契，攻势一浪高过一浪。
太古水帝要分心守护纪元本源，无法全力作战，渐渐有些力不从心。
空和楚毕竟只是普通的烙印，连分身都算不上，力量并非无穷无尽，战斗了数千万回合之后，气息也开始微微紊乱。
叶无缺的消耗更是巨大，半步超脱的境界终究是短板，若非有自身强大黄金天道提供力量，他早已支撑不住。
“哈哈哈，撑不住了吧？”
不祥之主狂笑一声，攻势愈发猛烈：
“等炼化了你们，荒仙纪元便是我等囊中之物！”
“到时候，抽取整个纪元的本源，献给主宰大人，吾等定能再进一步！”
“给我破！”
不祥之主猛地祭出一面漆黑的大旗，大旗一展，无数不祥冤魂呼啸而出，形成一道恐怖的黑色龙卷，狠狠撞在太古水帝的水幕之上。
水幕终于不堪重负，彻底碎裂！
太古水帝闷哼一声，嘴角溢出一抹蓝色的血液。
“水帝！”
叶无缺瞳孔一缩，连忙闪身挡在太古水帝身前。
“小虫子，找死！”
不祥之尊抓住机会，一掌拍向叶无缺的后心。
这一掌蕴含了永恒超脱巅峰的全力一击，足以将普通超脱者打得形神俱灭！
“无缺小心！”
楚和空同时变色，想要救援却已来不及。
沉重的一掌结结实实地印在了叶无缺的后背上。
叶无缺身形猛地一颤，一口金色的鲜血喷涌而出。
但他没有倒下。
非但没有倒下，那股磅礴的不祥之力涌入体内，反而像是一道钥匙，彻底冲开了他体内那层最后的壁垒！
原本稳固的半步超脱道基，在巨大的压力与毁灭之力的冲刷下，开始碎裂、重组。
浑身力量这一刻疯狂运转，黄金天道之力熊熊燃烧，与超脱法则彻底融为一体！
content_en:
"Eternal time and space destroyed!"
Chu's figure turned into a golden lightning, traveling at extremely fast speeds between the five people.
Every time it flashes, there will be a sharp lightning strike, specializing in the enemy's weaknesses, being cunning and ruthless.
For a moment, the two beings, the King of Eternal Night and the Demon Lord of Samsara, were forced to retreat one after another.
Ye Wuque was not idle either.
He knew that he was at the lowest level, so he did not use the Eternal Transcendence level attack. Instead, relying on his understanding of the laws of time and space, he wandered around the edge of the battlefield, specifically targeting the flaws in the five people's moves to harass them.
The war reached a stalemate.
For a time, the entire core area of ​​the Desolate Immortal Era collapsed, time and space collapsed, and countless stars turned into ashes in the aftermath.
This is a terrifying war that can destroy an era!
However, as time went by, Zhutian's disadvantage gradually became apparent.
The five eternal gods joined forces and cooperated with each other tacitly, and their attacks became higher and higher.
The ancient water emperor was too distracted to protect the origin of the era, unable to fight with all his strength, and gradually became unable to do what he wanted.
After all, Kong and Chu were just ordinary imprints, not even clones, and their power was not infinite. After fighting for tens of millions of rounds, their auras began to become slightly disordered.
Ye Wuque's consumption was even greater. The half-step transcendence was ultimately his shortcoming. Without the power provided by his own powerful golden heaven, he would have been unable to sustain it.
"Hahaha, can't you hold it anymore?"
The ominous Lord laughed wildly, and his attack became more fierce:
"When you are refined, the Desolate Immortal Era will be in our pocket!"
"When the time comes, extract the origin of the entire era and dedicate it to Lord Overlord, and we will definitely be able to make further progress!"
"Break it for me!"
The ominous Lord suddenly raised a dark flag. As soon as the flag was unfolded, countless ominous souls roared out, forming a terrifying black tornado and slamming into the water curtain of the Ancient Water Emperor.
"Click——!!!"
The water curtain was finally overwhelmed and completely shattered!
The Ancient Water Emperor groaned, and a touch of blue blood overflowed from the corner of his mouth.
"Water Emperor!"
Ye Wuque's pupils shrank and he quickly stepped in front of the Ancient Water Emperor.
"Little bug, you are seeking death!"
The Ominous Lord seized the opportunity and slapped Ye Wuque in the back of the heart.
This palm contains a powerful blow at the pinnacle of eternal transcendence, which is enough to beat an ordinary transcendent into physical and mental destruction!
"Be careful!"
Chu and Kong changed their colors at the same time, but it was too late to rescue them.
"Pfft!!!"
A heavy palm imprinted firmly on Ye Wuque's back.
Ye Wuque's body trembled suddenly, and a mouthful of golden blood spurted out.
But he didn't fall.
Not only did he not fall down, the majestic and ominous power poured into his body, but it was like a key, completely breaking open the last barrier in his body!
The originally stable foundation of half-step transcendence began to fragment and reorganize under the erosion of huge pressure and destructive power.
The whole body's strength is running wildly at this moment, the power of golden heaven is burning, and it is completely integrated with the law of transcendence!
"This is……"
